engineeringSkip.reason: Algorithmic governance is a governance and policy concept — the use of automated decision systems in public administration — rather than a technology that can be engineered and built, and its described mechanism of blockchain smart contracts running city-state infrastructure is speculative framing rather than a real technical programme.
